# agentsmith

> Cross-environment agent asset manager — install, sync, and update agent skills, instructions, and agents across VS Code, Kiro, Antigravity, and more.

agentsmith is an open-source Node.js CLI (MIT licence) that helps developers discover, install,
and lifecycle-manage agent assets from the awesome-copilot community catalogue across multiple
AI development environments. It translates frontmatter conventions between environments
(VS Code `applyTo`, Kiro `inclusion`, Antigravity `trigger`) and tracks installations with
SHA-256 hash-based change detection to protect local edits.

## Key pages

- README: https://github.com/CTOUT/agentsmith/blob/main/README.md
- Changelog: https://github.com/CTOUT/agentsmith/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ctout-uk/agentsmith

## Quick usage

```bash
npx @ctout-uk/agentsmith sync
npx @ctout-uk/agentsmith install
```

## Supported environments

- VS Code (GitHub Copilot harness) — `.github/` and `~/.copilot/`
- Kiro — `.kiro/` and `~/.kiro/`
- Antigravity — `.agents/` and `~/.gemini/config/`
